stories.caption: NEW! Small Steps, Big Changes, For Preschool.  Inclusion. This bumper book is a Toolbox of Strategies to Implement Inclusive Education, published by the National Early Childhood Intervention Council (NECIC) Malaysia. Written by Lai-Thin Ng, seen here with the book. Lai-Thin is project lead at NECIC and Educator in Special and Inclusive Education. Front cover illustration by Branden Lim. DM us for more info or to purchase. RM50.
